subcategory_text: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
implementation_examples: Replace hardware when it lacks needed security capabilities or when it cannot support software with needed security capabilities
Define and implement plans for hardware end-of-life maintenance support and obsolescence
Perform hardware disposal in a secure, responsible, and auditable manner
assessment_objectives: Determine whether hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that replace hardware when it lacks needed security capabilities or when it cannot support software with needed security capabilities.
Determine whether activities are conducted to define and implement plans for hardware end-of-life maintenance support and obsolescence.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
